Refactor the template loader in engine.rs build_env() to implement three-tier resolution per REQ-014-004:

1. Tier 1 (User Theme): .zetl/themes/<active-theme>/<template>.html on disk
2. Tier 2 (Bundled Theme): bundled_template(active_theme, template) from compile-time embed
3. Tier 3 (Default Fallback): bundled_template("default", template) from compile-time embed

Current code only has Tier 1 (disk) and Tier 2 (hardcoded default). The change is:
- Replace the match statement in the loader with calls to bundled_template()
- Add the intermediate Tier 2 lookup for the active theme name
- Tier 3 is the final fallback to "default"

When --theme default: Tier 1 is skipped (existing behaviour), Tier 2 = Tier 3.
When --theme minimal: Tier 1 checks disk, Tier 2 checks bundled minimal/, Tier 3 falls back to bundled default/.
When --theme custom-user-theme: Tier 1 checks disk, Tier 2 has no bundled match (returns None), Tier 3 falls back to default.

Update validate_theme() in main.rs: currently it requires .zetl/themes/<name>/ to exist for non-default themes. It must now also accept names that match a bundled theme (bundled_theme_names().contains(theme)). A theme is valid if it exists on disk OR is bundled. Both can be true (installed shadows bundled).

Update verbose logging to show which tier resolved each template (OBS-014-002):
  theme: base.html  <- .zetl/themes/garden/base.html (disk)
  theme: index.html <- bundled:minimal/index.html
  theme: page.html  <- bundled:default/page.html (fallback)
